title: Groove on Fight (Japan): native cartridge-bus edits
summary: Remove four original ASR0 stores from the first and later programs.
rationale: The four original instructions store 23301FF0 into SCU ASR0 at 25FE00B0. Replace only those stores, preserving adjacent AREF writes and register/flag effects. Two belong to 1ST.BIN and two to G3_PROG.BIN. Complete source/production-decoder correspondence checks pass. Leave the original 00200460=06004000 entry pointer and its JSR delay-slot store to 00280008 unchanged; the copied helper's pointer repair was needed only by its own redirection. Native startup overwrites the helper's changed caller registers before the first main call. Two controlled 12000-frame comparisons against original-address and relocated inherited handlers match sampled video and complete PCM. The earlier mismatch is preserved and its changed test conditions remain unisolated; no synthetic delay is added. These are cartridge-bus compatibility edits, not CDON. No new code, resident callback or RAM writer is supplied. Keep inactive pending physical bus, audio, other-load and reset checks.
